finding: The apparent 1955/1972 conflict is better explained as item-level versus volume-level dating. Multiple bibliographies identify vol. 3 as an Egyptian General Book Authority edition from 1972, while vol. 1 (and in some records vol. 2) is dated 1955. Internet Archive's aggregate item carries publication_date=1955, but its separate vol.3 full-text OCR title-page block names الهيئة المصرية العامة للكتاب and a year OCRed as '201' (not safely decipherable without the image). In the vol.3 al-Kawthar section, the OCR footnote records هل أنت مكان ها أنت. Thus the 1972 imprint is strongly supported bibliographically and by the OCR imprint string, but its scanned title page and relevant poem page still need visual collation.
